targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-642 (2026-06-06) FAILed C0/C1/C2 with the comparator floored to outcome_mismatch=0 on every step. Failure autopsy (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-642_2026-06-06): untrained-substrate test-design artifact, NOT a falsification or substrate ceiling -- P0 trained world_forward on a frozen random encoder with SD-056 OFF, so pred_mag stayed below the 0.05 predicted-effect floor by construction (wf_mse~2e-5 is a low-variance-target fit, not a discriminative comparator). recommended_substrate_queue_entry.rationale: The substrate (encoder + SD-056) is implemented and contract-clean; it was simply not trained/enabled in the V3-EXQ-642 P0. No substrate enrichment is warranted until a corrected experiment (V3-EXQ-642a) trains it and STILL fails C0. The fix is a test redesign, not a substrate gap.

learning_extracted: Confirmed prerequisite: the SD-029 z_world action-outcome comparator (MECH-353 detector) requires a trained encoder + action-conditional world_forward (SD-056) before it can discriminate a blocked move from a successful one -- exactly as the MECH-353 design doc predicted. Positive evidence for the dependency, not against MECH-353.

wf_mse is not a substrate-readiness signal on its own: a low wf_mse over a low-variance (position-insensitive) z_world target is fully compatible with degenerate pred_mag ~ 0. Use pred_mag / SD-056 cand_world_pairwise_dist as the readiness metric instead.

A self-routing diagnostic still needs an autopsy: the manifest's substrate_ceiling_comparator_nondiscriminative label is right about the symptom (C0 non-discriminative) but wrong about the cause (untrained, not coarse). The grid's 'C0 fail -> substrate_ceiling' branch assumed a trained substrate; this run did not meet that precondition.

C3 (assert-not-withdraw) passed 2/3 only vacuously: with z_block identically 0 both arms are bit-identical, so 'no withdrawal / no suffering' is trivially satisfied. The negative-control-passes / discrimination-fails shape is genuine, but its cause here is untrained substrate.
